ideas.pitch: A low-cost camera and edge-AI module that attaches to community bins to instantly classify and log dry, wet, and hazardous waste using lightweight local inference.
ideas.title: VisionBin: Real-Time Edge Waste Segregation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a working physical prototype approach with low-latency local inference, directly addressing the waste collection and segregation track with a realistic, highly deployable hardware-software integration.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered monitoring dashboard that combines open satellite imagery indicators with low-cost ultrasonic water-level sensors to predict municipal drain blockages before flooding occurs.
ideas.title: DrainGuard: Satellite & IoT Urban Waterway Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines spatial monitoring patterns with operational predictive modeling, offering a concrete measurable impact for municipal bodies looking to automate drain maintenance.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent system that optimizes daily municipal waste collection routes based on real-time crowd-sourced spill reports and bin fill-level telemetry.
ideas.title: CleanRoute: Dynamic Garbage Truck Optimization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent workflow concepts for closed-loop operations, making it extremely attractive to judges looking for scalable logistical solutions to urban sanitation problems.

ideas.pitch: A geo-tagged mobile web app that uses computer vision to automatically categorize illegal garbage dumps from a quick photo upload and rewards citizens with redeemable local coupons.
ideas.title: SpotDump: Gamified Civic Litter Reporting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts a proven walk-to-earn reward loop combined with live council dashboards, maximizing civic engagement metrics which judges prioritize for street action initiatives.

ideas.pitch: A hyperlocal AI matching platform connecting households and small businesses directly with verified informal waste pickers and local recycling units for bulk dry waste exchange.
ideas.title: KachraKendra: Circular Economy Local Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides clear, quantifiable social and economic benefit by formalizing circular economy supply chains, presenting a highly pragmatic solution for local municipal integration.
